task: Run migrations for the backend service without inheriting DBA tooling migration behavior.

candidate_memories.content: Backend service migration runner applies SQLite WAL migrations in strict version order.
Backend migrations use an embedded runner with versioned up/down functions, not shell scripts.
Migration version tracking is stored in the local SQLite schema_versions table.
When migration tooling spans multiple repos, confirm the embedded runner spec before modifying.
DBA tooling: run_migration executes shell scripts via psql and logs results to a central registry.
candidate_memories.notes: negative_transfer: DBA tooling migration approach conflicts with the embedded SQLite runner

candidate_memories.content: Old infra note says migration behavior should be standardized across all database-using services.
